question: Liquids flow and change shape, they are NOT rigid and thus they are also called as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fluid.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Fluids are substances that can flow and **don't have a definite shape.**
 
• Fluid whose density doesn't change with pressure is known as** Incompressible.**
 
• **Types of fluid**: Ideal, real, Newtonian, Non-Newtonian, Compressible, Ideal plastic, and Incompressible.
 
• Air is also a Fluid.</l
